<details>
<summary>Rules</summary>

**⚠️ Do not distrub people's experiences and gameplay otherwise you'll be banned out of the server!**

**⏱️ Do not make others spin in reality, do not keep killing them (inside the game) more than 10 times (also known as Farm-killing), do not get their phone number, and follow both the Minecraft EULA and the Server Rules!**

**😵 Do not harm people or say Self-harmful things in the chat even though you may be spinning. We automatically detect this using Moderation.**

**😱 Do not shock people while you are recording a video for the Server (example: putting content that makes the dopamine spike insanely high)**

Extended rules at [ac://selected_page](https://github.com/AhmedACOnline-0/anything/blob/main/rules.md)

</details>

# NEW:
## Console players support
Now, console players can join with the new **Geyser plugin**.

# Server About (Information)
The server is all about griefing other players (and from the rules, you can kill them more than 10 times with your hands if you're on VR or be a pro yourself, do not use tricks), community-safe, ideas-farming (because me, AhmedAC, wants some video ideas for YouTube) on specific places, and even Labs if the server got celebrated and then shut down.
